name: Nevada

agency.name: Nevada Office of the Labor Commissioner

rates2026.area: Statewide (all employees, regardless of health benefits)
rates2026.note: 2026 annual bulletin (posted June 29, 2026) keeps $12.00 from July 1, 2026

minWage.headlineArea: Statewide (all employees, regardless of health benefits)

tipped.note: Tips may not be credited toward the minimum wage (NRS 608.160)

minWage.other: Two-tier (health-benefits) minimum wage eliminated as of July 1, 2024 (Ballot Question 2, 2022).

source.quote: Effective Date Minimum Wage July 1, 2026 $12.00 ... APPLIES TO ALL EMPLOYEES REGARDLESS OF OFFERED EMPLOYER HEALTH BENEFITS.

overtime.note: Daily overtime (over 8 hours in a 24-hour period) applies only to employees earning less than 1.5 times the minimum wage ($18.00/hour from July 1, 2026); a mutually agreed 4x10 schedule is excepted. Everyone non-exempt gets overtime after 40 hours/week.

source.quote: EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2026, EMPLOYEES WHO EARN LESS THAN $18.00 PER HOUR ARE ELIGIBLE FOR OVERTIME AT ONE AND A HALF (1.5) TIMES ... OVER 8 HOURS OF WORK IN A 24-HOUR PERIOD

sickLeave.accrual: 0.01923 hours of paid leave per hour worked (about 1 hour per 52 hours, i.e. roughly 40 hours a year full-time); usable for any reason
sickLeave.capNote: Private employers with 50+ employees in Nevada; carryover may be capped at 40 hours per benefit year (employer may also limit use to 40 hours per year). Not paid out at separation unless policy says so.
sickLeave.employerThreshold: 50 or more employees in Nevada (new employers exempt for first 2 years)
sickLeave.note: General paid leave (not limited to sickness) under NRS 608.0197.

source.quote: An employee is entitled to at least 0.01923 hours of paid leave for each hour of work performed.

finalPay.quit: by the next regular payday or within 7 days of quitting, whichever is earlier
finalPay.ptoNote: No statute requires payout of vacation or paid leave at separation; follows employer policy.

source.quote: Whenever an employer discharges an employee, the wages and compensation earned and unpaid at the time of such discharge shall become due and payable immediately.

breaks.meal: 30-minute meal period for a continuous 8-hour period
breaks.rest: Paid 10-minute rest period per 4 hours worked or major fraction thereof (none if under 3.5 hours a day); not required where only one person is employed

source.quote: The duration of the rest periods shall be based on the total hours worked daily at the rate of 10 minutes for each 4 hours or major fraction thereof.

rightToWorkSource.quote: No person shall be denied the opportunity to obtain or retain employment because of nonmembership in a labor organization

notes.text: Nevada gives private-sector workers at employers with 50+ employees paid leave they can use for any reason, without having to give a reason.

source.quote: every employer in private employment shall provide paid leave to each employee of the employer

notes.text: Lower-paid workers (under $18.00/hour in 2026) earn overtime after 8 hours in a 24-hour period, not just after 40 hours a week.

source.quote: EMPLOYEES WHO EARN LESS THAN $18.00 PER HOUR ARE ELIGIBLE FOR OVERTIME

notes.text: Employers cannot count tips toward the minimum wage: tipped workers get the full $12.00 plus their tips.

source.quote: Apply as a credit toward the payment of the statutory minimum hourly wage established by any law of this State any tips or gratuities

notes.text: Nevada's paid leave law (SB 312) took effect January 1, 2020.

source.quote: Paid Leave Effective January 1, 2020 – Nevada Revised Statutes (NRS) § 608

Re-check on the live sites.
accrualPerHours 52 is an approximation of 0.01923 h/h (1/52 = 0.01923).
